label: Living, operating from oneself: Lives x: x lives, i.e. operates from itself and not as moved by…
definition: `Lives x`: x lives, i.e. operates from itself and not as moved by another (ST I q.18 a.3 co.: vivere dicuntur aliqua secundum quod operantur ex seipsis). A timeless predicate, distinct from DEF-LIFE-PRESENT-AT (life present at a time). Example: an animal, a thinker; counterexample: a stone. Nothing fixes degrees of life.
note: Analyst vocabulary. AQUINAS-ST-I-Q18-A3-HIGHEST-LIFE records the q.18 a.3 sense (things live insofar as they act from themselves); a sourced definition would need that claim to state the definition, not only the highest-life thesis.
